metadata.title: Moon Fashion
metadata.description: Moon Fashion — luxury fashion, edited for the modern wardrobe.

evening.body: A refined wardrobe for modern femininity.
evening.imageAlt: A woman in a long-sleeved black velvet column gown, standing in a dark marble hall

linen.body: Washed linen and open weaves for long, warm days.
linen.imageAlt: A woman in an ivory linen dress with wide straps walking across a shaded stone courtyard

abaya.body: Fluid abayas in silk crepe and soft chiffon.
abaya.imageAlt: A woman in a flowing black abaya over a brown dress, standing by a lattice window

knitwear.body: Cashmere and wool in the warm tones of the season.
knitwear.imageAlt: A woman in a cream cashmere sweater and brown wide trousers, standing in a dark wood-panelled room

banner.title: The Silk Edit
banner.body: Fluid blouses and soft tailoring in ivory and warm brown.
banner.imageAlt: A woman in an ivory silk blouse with full sleeves and a long brown linen skirt, seated on a stone ledge in warm light

featured.title: The Evening Edit
featured.body: Silk, velvet and hand embroidery for the hours after dark.
featured.largeAlt: A woman in a champagne satin evening gown seated on lamplit limestone steps
featured.smallAlt: Hands holding a black velvet clutch with a gold clasp against champagne satin

campaign.imageAlt: A woman in a flowing umber silk dress walking through a limestone colonnade at dusk

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.body: Every order is carefully packed and delivered to your address.

returns.title: Considered fabrics
returns.body: Silk, linen, cashmere and wool, chosen for how they feel and wear.

payment.title: Secure payment
payment.body: Your payment details are kept protected.
